title: aristolochia claussenii subsp. pyrenea
intro: Aristolochia claussenii subsp. pyrenea, commonly known as the Pyrenean birthwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Aristolochia genus. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues and skin problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aristolochia claussenii subsp. pyrenea include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aristolochic acids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
